title: Outdoor Condenser Fan Frost Seizure in Extreme Cold / Humid Weather
model: Home Split AC Cooling & Gas Leak Troubleshooter
operating_conditions: Outdoor ambient temperature < 4°C with freezing fog or wet snow
summary: Frost buildup can mechanically jam outdoor fan blades during reverse-cycle heat pump heating in near-freezing moist weather.

ordered_checks.action: Switch off mains electrical isolator switch near the outdoor condenser unit.
ordered_checks.hazard_notice: Ensure power is completely cut before reaching near fan shroud.

ordered_checks.action: Visually inspect fan grille. If ice bridges blades to shroud, gently pour 2 liters of warm tap water (40-50°C) across fan hub to melt ice bridge.
ordered_checks.hazard_notice: Do not strike fan blades with hammer or sharp objects as plastic may fracture.

ordered_checks.action: Ensure bottom drain holes in outdoor unit base-pan are cleared of autumn leaves and ice plugs.
Restore isolator switch and engage Defrost Heat cycle from remote controller.
ordered_checks.hazard_notice: Allow 10 minutes for automated heat pump defrost cycle to complete.

title: Front-Load Washer Walking & Drum Thumping on Bulky Laundry Load (UE / Ub Code)
model: Front-Load Washing Machine Motor & Drain Pump Assistant
operating_conditions: Washing single heavy item (bedsheet, rug, heavy bathmat) or unlevel tile flooring
summary: Single bulky item bunches into one side of drum, triggering centrifugal acceleration imbalance protection.

ordered_checks.action: Press Pause button and wait 60 seconds for door lock solenoid to release.
ordered_checks.hazard_notice: Do not force door handle while lock symbol is lit.

ordered_checks.action: Open door and redistribute wet laundry evenly around circumference of stainless steel drum; add 2 smaller dry towels to balance center of mass.
ordered_checks.hazard_notice: Avoid washing single heavy wet articles in isolation.

ordered_checks.action: Place spirit bubble level on top metal lid; rotate adjustable front rubber feet until bubble is centered, then tighten locking nuts.
ordered_checks.hazard_notice: All 4 feet must make firm friction contact with floor.

ordered_checks.action: Select Spin Only program at reduced 800 RPM instead of maximum 1400 RPM.
ordered_checks.hazard_notice: Reduced RPM prevents excessive centrifugal shock.

title: Dual Evaporator Refrigerator Fan Ticking Sound Due to Frost Ice Growth
operating_conditions: Humid summer weather, freezer door left ajar, or warm food placed in freezer
symptoms: ticking or chirping sound from freezer
fan stops when door is opened
summary: Warm moist air infiltration causes frost buildup along circulation fan cowl, producing clicking noise as blade tips strike frost.

ordered_checks.action: Perform dollar bill seal test: Close freezer door on a paper currency note and pull. It should offer firm resistance along entire magnetic perimeter.
ordered_checks.hazard_notice: Clean any sticky syrup or ice crystals from rubber door gasket.

ordered_checks.action: Verify freezer food packages are placed at least 5cm away from rear return air louvers to allow unobstructed convective airflow.
ordered_checks.hazard_notice: Do not block air return ports with bulk frozen bags.

ordered_checks.action: Initiate Manual Forced Defrost (Fd mode) from digital control panel (Press Energy Saver + Power Freeze for 8 seconds).
ordered_checks.hazard_notice: System will activate defrost element for 25 minutes to melt fan shroud frost.
